flags.message: The provisioned appendix is truncated at the 150,000-character cap, ending within the Thapar/Hermandorfer rehearing dissent and omitting the later Bush and Readler opinions. Their positions were considered only as characterized in the provisioned petition and reply. No body-camera recordings were viewed; the forecast relies on the competing filing descriptions and panel treatment. These limitations reduce confidence in the proposed summary-reversal vehicle; they do not block prediction.
